rows.title: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
rows.summary: Tejas Networks Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of a  Letter of Intent  dated August 27, 2026, from Tata Consultancy Services Limited ( TCS ) for supply of RAN equipment, accessories & installation materials for BSNL 4G mobile network for 18,685 sites, valued at Rs.1537 Crores.
